name: deepresearch-bench-query
description: A dataset of information-seeking queries and associated expected answers intended to evaluate models' ability to handle research-style or knowledge-intensive queries (retrieval and answer generation). It measures both retrieval relevance and answer correctness over scientific or technical content. Entries are used to benchmark QA/retrieval pipelines and open-ended answer generation under research/querying scenarios.
evaluation_method: exact_match / F1 (answer correctness) and retrieval relevance metrics
reputation: A small, task-focused Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing usage among researchers working on retrieval and QA for research queries.
